evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/r extends the reviewed MultiplexingPluginPanel, captures one EventBus and one PluginListPanel, and overrides only the add/remove hooks.
The add hook calls EventBus.register on the incoming PluginPanel and the remove hook calls EventBus.unregister on that same panel.
RuneLite PluginListPanel constructs an anonymous MultiplexingPluginPanel(this) whose onAdd registers the PluginPanel with EventBus and whose onRemove unregisters it, matching v308 exactly.

proposals.note: PluginListPanelEventBusMultiplexer is a descriptive source-parity name for RuneLite's anonymous MultiplexingPluginPanel subclass owned by PluginListPanel.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/p extends MouseAdapter, captures one JPopupMenu and one JLabel, converts the current screen pointer to the clicked component's coordinates, and shows the popup at that exact point.
The same adapter saves the label's current foreground on mouseEntered, applies the reviewed RuneLite brand color, and restores the saved foreground on mouseExited.
RuneLite PluginListItem.addLabelPopupMenu contains the same anonymous MouseAdapter with lastForeground, pointer conversion, popup show, BRAND_ORANGE hover and restore behavior.

proposals.note: PluginListItemPopupMouseListener is a descriptive source-parity name for the anonymous popup/hover adapter inside PluginListItem.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/s implements DocumentListener, captures one reviewed PluginListPanel, and insertUpdate/removeUpdate/changedUpdate all invoke the same PluginListPanel search-refresh method.
RuneLite PluginListPanel installs an anonymous DocumentListener on the search bar whose three callbacks all call onSearchBarChanged(), exactly matching v308.

proposals.note: PluginListPanelSearchDocumentListener is a descriptive source-parity name for the anonymous search-bar DocumentListener inside PluginListPanel.
